description:
Price one search_trips option exactly as it will be booked: the chosen vehicle, the party and any stops. Returns everything the traveler must see before committing (seller, total price and currency, what is included, when they are charged, cancellation policy and free-cancellation deadline) and a single-use quoteId for book_trip.

Returns one of:
- status "quoted": present price, cancellationTerms and paymentTiming to the traveler; if previousPrice is set, the price differs from the search option and must be confirmed again. The quote can be booked until expiresAt; afterwards call get_quote again.
- status "offer_expired" (OFFER_EXPIRED): the search option is gone; call search_trips again.
- status "route_not_available" (ROUTE_NOT_AVAILABLE): the trip can no longer be priced; call search_trips again or suggest alternatives.
- status "invalid_input" (INVALID_INPUT): the vehicleType or a stop does not belong to that offer, or a customStops place could not be resolved; the message says what to fix.

Nothing is reserved and no personal data is needed. Each call prices the trip afresh.

adults.description: Number of adult passengers, including the lead traveler.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code to show the price in as well; use the one from search_trips.

customStops.description: Stops at places not in availableStops. The trip is then routed and priced through them, so the price will differ from the search.

locale.description: Language of the traveler's pages and emails (en, de, es, fr, pt).

offerId.description: offerId of the chosen search_trips option.

stops.description: Sightseeing stops from the search's availableStops the customer wants to add, in any order.

durationMinutes.description: Time at the stop; defaults to the stop's defaultDurationMinutes.

locationId.description: locationId of an availableStops entry from search_trips.

vehicleType.description: vehicle.type of the chosen search_trips option (a class identifier such as sedan or van).
